INCIDENT TYPE:
CREDENTIAL STUFFING

DESCRIPTION:
Credential stuffing occurs when attackers use usernames and passwords obtained from previous breaches to gain unauthorized access to accounts on other services.

THREAT FRAMEWORK:
- MITRE ATT&CK | T1110.004 | Credential Stuffing

INDICATORS:
- High-volume login attempts
- Multiple accounts accessed from one IP
- Login attempts using breached credentials
- Increased account lockouts

DETECTION RULES:
- Login velocity anomalies
- Repeated login attempts across users

AFFECTED ASSETS:
- User accounts
- Authentication platforms
title: CREDENTIAL STUFFING
